key_insight: SQD is broadly robust to imperfect inputs and hardware choices, but its recovery dynamics show diminishing returns and some sensitivity to deployment settings.
engineering_relevance: For practical quantum workflows, this suggests moderate shot counts and reasonable initialization quality are usually sufficient, while layout and mitigation choices matter most early in recovery.
method: Ran SQD on IBM Heron hardware
Compared shot budgets, qubit layouts, and noise-mitigation settings
Tested structured CCSD-amplitude perturbations, including complete zeroing
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that robustness was evaluated across hardware and initialization settings, with large first-iteration differences that narrow after a few recovery steps and accuracy that saturates at moderate shot budgets.
watch_item: Very large shot budgets can slightly worsen recovered energies, likely because working-set selection limits the benefit of extra samples.
paper_title: Hardware Robustness of Sample-Based Quantum Diagonalization
